The protests this week have made me again realise why I am doing this research into electoral registration. The UK & US are two of the only 'democracies' to employ voluntary electoral registration. With this comes barriers to information on how citizens can actually register 1/n

Information costs are unsurprisingly higher to working class people but most notably is the sickeningly disproportionate levels of racialized minorities present on electoral registers. UK registers are overwhelmingly white, older, and middle class.

My metaphor may need some work but I believe work on electoral registration is vital in getting minority voices, oppressed voices, important voices heard. The game is currently set-up against racialized minorities, disabled people, young people, & the disabled.
